stories.title: Anthropic allocates 5% of IPO shares to Public Benefit Fund, creating $80 billion endowment
stories.summary: Anthropic’s IPO set aside roughly 5% of its shares—about 850 million—to a Public Benefit Fund. Using the reported trading price of about $95 per share, the fund is valued at approximately $80 billion. The PBF’s first commitment is $200 million to study AI’s impact on workers, and the company separately donated $50 million to San Francisco, which it says came from its own resources, not the PBF.
stories.why: The fund provides a sizable, dedicated capital source for AI safety research and broader philanthropic initiatives, potentially shaping the industry’s societal impact.

stories.title: European leaders say they are ready to negotiate with Russia on Ukraine war
stories.summary: European leaders at Berlin's "Coalition of the Willing" summit said Europe has a clear, united negotiating position and is prepared to discuss ending the war in Ukraine with Russia. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz criticised Moscow's maximalist demands as unrealistic. US envoy Jared Kushner noted President Trump wants a deal with Moscow alongside Europe, while President Putin has rejected any European role in US‑led talks.
stories.why: It signals a potential shift toward diplomatic engagement that could affect efforts to resolve the Ukraine conflict.

stories.title: Goldman Sachs names 22 ‘high-growth’ stocks; Bharti Airtel, Eternal and HDFC Bank feature in the list
stories.summary: Against this backdrop, Goldman Sachs has identified 22 high-growth companies with exposure to structural growth themes and initiated Buy ratings on 21 of them. stories.title: India needs $430 billion in exports in five months to meet FY27 target
stories.summary: Union Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal said India must achieve about $430 billion in exports from November to March to meet its FY27 goal, after reaching 57 % of the target by the end of October. October exports hit an all‑time high of nearly $90 billion, and the government aims for $1 trillion in total exports for the fiscal year.
stories.why: Trade developments can affect currencies, business costs, market access and the external balance of the economies involved.
